title: Pierre Deligne Papers and Letters: Working Translation Drafts and Source/QA Packets
description:
This record contains Pierre Deligne paper and letter working drafts, organized as a reader-first public surface. The latest cleanup fronts the sequential cumulative English and French readers for Papers 001-016p080, groups individual paper and letter PDFs by language, and groups TeX/source-check/QA/update material into a separate artifact ZIP.

Status caveat. These are useful working drafts and source/QA packets, not a critical edition and not a blanket source-faithfulness claim. Deligne material is uneven: some papers and letters are strong working drafts, while diagram-heavy and equation-dense pieces still require source comparison.

Use rule. Open the cumulative readers first. Use the English/French grouped PDF ZIPs for individual papers and letters. Use the TeX/source/QA ZIP for checking and repair. Check commutative diagrams, dense formulas, references, and theorem statements against source witnesses before relying on them.

GitHub. Corrections and pull requests can be made through https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Reader-first cleanup: replaces 100 loose files with cumulative readers, grouped English/French paper-letter PDF ZIPs, grouped TeX/source/QA/update ZIP, and status caveat.
